mapper.select: select * from byai_session_member where session_id = #{sessionId} order by case when mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' then 3 when user_role = 'OWNER' then 0 when user_role = 'ADMIN' then 1 else 2 end, byai_session_member_id asc

select byai_session_member_id, session_id, mem_obj_type, mem_obj_id, user_role, create_time, creator_id, mem_name, request_count, last_read_message_id, last_read_time, com_acct_id from byai_session_member where session_id = #{sessionId} and mem_obj_type = #{memObjType} and mem_obj_id = #{memObjId} limit 1

update byai_session_member
session_id = #{sessionId},
mem_obj_type = #{memObjType},
mem_obj_id = #{memObjId},
user_role = #{userRole},
create_time = #{createTime},
creator_id = #{creatorId},
mem_name = #{memName},
request_count = #{requestCount},
com_acct_id = #{comAcctId},
where byai_session_member_id = #{byaiSessionMemberId}
mapper.select: select byai_session_member_id, session_id, mem_obj_type, mem_obj_id, user_role, create_time, creator_id, mem_name, request_count, com_acct_id from byai_session_member where mem_obj_id = #{memObjId} and mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' and create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time <= #{endTime}

select a.session_id, a.parent_session_id, a.session_name, a.session_content, a.session_type, a.create_time, a.creator_id, a.object_type, a.object_id, a.enterprise_id, a.update_time from byai_session a where a.creator_id = #{userId} and ( a.session_id in ( select b.session_id from byai_session_member b where b.mem_obj_type = 'AGENT' and b.mem_obj_id = #{objectId} ) or a.object_id = #{objectId} )
and (a.session_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.session_content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by a.update_time desc, a.create_time desc
